HOW IT HELPS

How it works
in everyday life.

We are working on a way to book visits to local administrative service centres (CNAP) through CITI. Participating centres will be able to offer digital tickets and payments for supported services.

When it comes in handy

Need to visit your local service centre? Once booking is available, you can choose an appointment time before heading there.

This service is in development. Availability will depend on your local centre.

All features

Live public transport

Track buses and trolleybuses on the map, find routes and stops, and check estimated arrival times in CITI.

City parking

Find paid and free parking from municipal and private operators. Parking in CITI is currently in testing.

Utility bills and meter readings

CITI is working on a way to view outstanding balances, pay utility bills and submit meter readings from your phone.
